1.

Our Lord Jesus Christ, Who once died for us, What joy to see Thee now exalted And praise Thee with song.

2.

In love was Thy path, Which God alone understood; Ever the word of grace from Thy mouth Gave sorrowing hearts courage.

3.

O love, which so brightly Despite sorrow and opposition burned, A love which has purchased us for God And won full atonement.

4.

A love which for us Into death’s valley descended, And the light of God’s heart-law In the world’s darkness spread.

5.

And now with glory crowned, High above the heavens, Thou sittest on Thy Father’s throne, His heart’s Beloved.

6.

Soon we in glory With Thee shall reign, Thy love to Thine own then Shall be seen by all the world.

7.

Thee, Jesus, we await, Thou art our soul’s desire. Our joy it shall be eternally To be where Thou art.
